blocks.text: Day 4 · Breakfast, then a jungle walk and a visit to a caboclo family’s house, learning how manioc flour is made. Visit the village of Acajatuba, whose people live from manioc plantations, fishing and fruits such as tucumã, cupuaçu and açaí, as well as rubber and Brazil-nut trees, and make crafts with natural seeds from the jungle. After dinner, explore the riverbank by searchlight to spot caimans, and sometimes nighthawks, snakes and frogs.
